critical_premises: Huang's arbitrary-initial two-mode asymptotic upper bound.
Huang's exact normalized diagonal recurrence and fixed-diagonal affine recurrence.
unproved_limits: No statement about optimal transient constants or varying relaxation parameters.

scientific_limitations: Restricted to the constant-parameter projection-mean iteration on \(\operatorname{UT}_2\).
The result concerns the exponential asymptotic rate and does not optimize transient constants or finite-step error.
No corresponding exact minimax formula is asserted for \(\operatorname{UT}_n\) with \(n>2\).
An equivalent short minimax corollary under generic stationary-iteration terminology remains a residual literature risk.
title: Exact minimax relaxation for the \(\operatorname{UT}_2\) projection mean
